data.spec: apps/speech/speaker_id.py (speech venv, sherpa-onnx). Default model wespeaker_en_voxceleb_resnet34_LM.onnx (auto-downloads to .data/models), 16 kHz mono float32 input. SpeakerID().enroll(name, *float32_16k_clips); .identify(audio) -> Match(name|None, score, best). Cosine threshold DEFAULT_THRESHOLD=0.7 (below -> name None). Voiceprints stored locally in ignored .data/. CLI: enroll NAME, identify, list, remove NAME, selftest. stt.py gains --identify flag printing '👤 name (score)' or 'unknown speaker'. Identity is informational only and never grants purchasing authority.

evidence: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 0.7 ... DEFAULT_MODEL = "wespeaker_en_voxceleb_resnet34_LM.onnx"; Identity is informational only (e.g. "requested by")
